summary: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing a 1-for-10 reverse stock split of its ordinary shares, effective at the open on October 16, 2026, when split-adjusted trading begins on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under KNDI. Pre-split shares outstanding total 103,002,499, including 2,077,134 repurchased in 2024. Par value rises from $0.001 to $0.01, and the new CUSIP is G5214E111. The board approved the split; no advisor was named. Fractional shares round up, ownership percentages are otherwise unchanged, and no arbitrage angle applies.
